newsitem.title: UK: Standard Chartered dealing profits down.
newsitem.headline: Standard Chartered dealing profits down.

text.p: Dealing profits at British Banking group Standard Chartered Plc slipped to 213 million pounds in 1996 from 240 million in 1995.
Standard Chartered said income from foreign exchange dealing slid to 164 million pounds from 190 million pounds in 1995.

"Reductions in foreign exchange income, as a result of generally lower volatility and reduced customer opportunity in the major currency markets, was compensated by higher profits from asset and liability management," the bank said in a statement following its 1996 results.
Dealing profits in the Asia Pacific region, a key to group's future, were up however at 36 million pounds in 1996 from 32 million in 1995.
Group securities profits were up to 22 million pounds from 18 million in 1995 while other dealing profits slid to 27 million from 32 million pounds in 1995.
Earlier on Wednesday, the banking group said its pre-tax profits rose 32 percent to 870 million pounds in the year ended December 31, 1996.
